picks.title: Why Healing My Internal World Changed Every Relationship in My External World — The Spiritual and Personal Growth That Showed Me How to Outgrow Old Patterns and Live a Life Full of Purpose and Passion
picks.summary: What if changing your relationships starts with changing what’s happening inside you?In this deeply personal episode of WE, Joe Mittiga shares how healing old emotional wounds transformed the way he experienced love, relationships, spirituality, and himself. He explores why some relationships deepen as we grow while others must change or be released, and how healing from the inside out can lead to greater freedom, purpose, connection, and peace.This episode is an invitation to stop looking outside yourself for what may be waiting to be healed within.
picks.reason: Describes how inner healing transforms relationships and personal growth.

picks.title: EP: 460 What REALLY Happened On The Mountaintop with Robby Gallaty
picks.summary: The Transfiguration might be the strangest scene in the Gospels. Jesus climbs a mountain, his face lights up, and two men who have been dead for centuries, Moses and Elijah, are suddenly standing there talking with him. Most sermons rush right past it. Robby Gallaty wants to stop and sit in the weirdness. Robby is the senior pastor of Long Hollow Church in Hendersonville, Tennessee, the founder of Replicate Ministries, and a preacher with a PhD who has given his life to making disciples. And he says that to understand the Transfiguration, you have to understand the mountain. Set against Mount
picks.reason: Stops to reflect on the mysterious Transfiguration event in the Gospels.
